label.zh: 激活十二面体：代达罗斯封印

note.zh: 探索结束，获得遗珍“代达罗斯封印”。
note.en: The exploration ends with the relic Daedalus Seal.

note.zh: 探索结束，获得暗物质与大量星界丝缕。
note.en: The exploration ends with dark matter and a large astral thread reward.

notes.zh: 抽取权重 1；游牧帝国为 0。它可能奖励遗珍，因此当任一帝国正在探索它时，其他帝国抽到它的权重为 0；若探索者没有拿到遗珍，探索结束后解除锁定。
notes.en: Draw weight 1, 0 for nomadic empires. Because it can award a relic, its weight is 0 for everyone while any empire is exploring it; if the explorer did not obtain the relic the lock is lifted when the exploration ends.

notes.zh: “演化猎手”起源的帝国在此看到专属选项（exclusive_trigger），额外获得该起源局势进度与 DNA。
notes.en: Evolutionary Predators empires see an exclusive option here (exclusive_trigger) that also grants progress and DNA for the origin's situation.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义（游牧限制、遗珍锁定）与 200–225 全部事件；编译结构无误，补充结局与条件说明。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition (nomad exclusion, relic lock) and every event 200–225; the compiled structure is correct; endings and condition notes added.
